    level="1"
    right="Item 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Alicorn Hair](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3254)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Catalyst" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=791" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 118

**Price** 4 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><row>[Cast a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734) (add 1 action)</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Hair shed from an [alicorn's](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3320) mane glows when it comes into contact with a living creature. A [_stabilize_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1689) spell empowered with an _alicorn hair_ allows you to target 1 additional creature.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
